column2: 不小于该大小的文件先写入 xxx.fengsync.partial，传输完成后改名发布，中断后可从断点继续（下载方向）。填 0 表示所有文件都续传；支持 500M、2G 这类写法。低于该大小使用 rclone 多流传输，速度更快但中断后需重新开始。
column3: Files at or above this size are written to xxx.fengsync.partial first and renamed into place when the transfer finishes, so an interrupted download resumes where it stopped. 0 resumes every file; values like 500M and 2G are accepted. Below the threshold rclone uses multi-stream transfers, which are faster but restart from the beginning.

column3: These settings affect uploads and downloads in cloud management only. They do not change a Profile's sync job.

column2: 同时传输数可在传输窗口里临时调整，这里设置的是每次启动时的默认值。重试次数填 0 表示失败后直接报告；无论填几，都能在传输窗口里手动重试。
column3: The transfer window can change the number of concurrent transfers temporarily; the value here is what each launch starts from. 0 retries means a failure is reported straight away. Whatever you choose, the transfer window can always retry by hand.

column2: 留空或填 0 表示不限速；支持 500K、2M 这类写法。限速是 rclone 的进程级设置——实测它不接受按端点分别限速（core/bwlimit 只收一个速率），所以这里设的值对云端浏览、上传、下载一视同仁，并且只在有传输进行时生效，传输结束就恢复不限速。
column3: Empty or 0 means no limit; values like 500K and 2M are accepted. The limit belongs to the rclone process: measured against rclone, it cannot be set per endpoint (core/bwlimit takes a single rate), so the value here applies equally to browsing, uploading and downloading, and only while a transfer is running — it goes back to unlimited once the transfers finish.

column2: 仅在此时间段传输（开始）
仅在此时间段传输（结束）
格式 HH:mm，留空表示任何时间都可以传输。时段外排队中的传输会一直等待，不会被取消；跨午夜（如 22:00–06:00）按一整段处理。实测 rclone 的限速时间表只能改速率、不能让传输停下来，所以这一项由本程序在队列上实现。
column3: Format HH:mm; empty means transfers may run at any time. Transfers queued outside the window keep waiting and are never cancelled, and a window that crosses midnight (22:00–06:00) is treated as one span. Measured against rclone, its bandwidth schedule can only change the rate, not stop a transfer, so this one is implemented on the queue.

column2: 只在整批传输全部成功时才触发；有任何一项失败就只报告，不会关机。执行前会再确认一次，因此需要保持传输窗口打开——没有人能应答的确认框不应该变成一次关机。
column3: It runs only when the whole batch succeeded; a single failure means the action is just reported and nothing shuts down. It asks once more before running, so keep the transfer window open — a confirmation nobody can answer should not turn into a shutdown.

column2: 留空表示自动：先用环境变量里的 HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY，再用 Windows 的 Internet 选项。填写 host:port（如 proxy.corp:8080）或带协议的完整地址（如 http://proxy.corp:8080、socks5://127.0.0.1:1080）。只影响本程序自己启动的 rclone 进程——云盘浏览、挂载、SFTP 服务与同步任务都会走它，不会修改系统或其他程序的代理设置。代理在 rclone 启动时确定，改动需重启程序后才生效。
column3: Empty means automatic: first the HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY environment variables, then the Windows Internet options. Enter host:port (for example proxy.corp:8080) or a full address with a scheme (http://proxy.corp:8080, socks5://127.0.0.1:1080). This affects only the rclone processes this program starts — cloud browsing, mounts, the SFTP service and sync jobs all go through it — and never changes the system or another program's proxy settings. The proxy is fixed when rclone starts, so a change takes effect after a restart.

column2: 留空表示每次下载都询问保存位置。设置了目录后，同名文件仍会在覆盖前确认。
column3: Empty means every download asks where to save it. With a folder set, a file of the same name is still confirmed before it is overwritten.

column2: 留空或填 0 表示不限制缓存大小（rclone 的默认值），缓存会一直增长到磁盘占满。这里是新建挂载的默认值，单个挂载可以在挂载对话框的“高级选项”里单独覆盖。缓存目录与占用大小在云盘管理窗口的挂载区域可以查看和清理。
column3: Empty or 0 means the cache is not capped (rclone's own default), and it grows until the disk is full. This is the default for new mounts; an individual mount can override it under "Advanced" in the mount dialog. The cache folder and its size can be inspected and cleared in the mounts area of the cloud manager window.
